files.name: MOON_nomenclature_center_pts.zip
files.credit: Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature, IAU Working Group for Planetary System Nomenclature (WGPSN) and USGS Astrogeology Science Center. U.S. Government work in the public domain; cite the Gazetteer (https://planetarynames.wr.usgs.gov).
files.use: centre points, diameters and type codes of IAU-approved lunar feature names; geography/nomenclature.py reads the archive's dBase table to label seas, islands and targets in the atlas
files.edition_note: The USGS regenerates this archive as names are approved. A new edition changes the size and hash and is reviewed before use.

publication_note: Retrieval and checksum verification are separate from reading the underlying publications. LOLA heights are in the mean-Earth/polar-axis frame and GL0420A in the DE421 principal-axis frame; the offset (about 0.02 degrees) is below the resolution of the geoid used here.
